result:
T-DG3-KBE-B is done: all 11 business-case operations are routed and tested, and every acceptance check exits 0. To keep the tree compiling and green I had to edit two files outside my ownership list, which you need to confirm. Nothing is committed.

**What works now (REQ-PB-053, REQ-PB-054, REQ-PB-055 baseline part, REQ-S05-005):**
- **Transformation case:** one active per transformation, with all ten B0085 sections stored and read back. `missingSections` lists what is still needed.
- **Initiative cases:** each links to that transformation case and uses the lighter section set.
- **Lines:** each line has exactly one class.
  - Two classes are rejected with 400 at `/class`.
  - A class that doesn't fit the kind, or a value basis that doesn't fit the class, is rejected with 422.
  - Amounts are decimal strings fitting numeric(20,4); null means Unknown.
  - Non-financial benefits can't carry an amount.
  - One benefit formula can back only one active line (409 otherwise).
- **Totals:**
  - Gross benefits, implementation cost (cash and non-cash shown apart) and net value are reported separately, per currency.
  - Revenue uplift stays apart from margin, and avoided cost from cash savings.
  - A transformation case adds in its initiative cases' lines by reference, each line counted once. The integration test edits an initiative line and checks the roll-up changes without any line being copied.
  - Unknown is never shown as 0.
- **Finance baseline validation:** only a FIN holder can validate, and the case's author gets 403. The validation stores a hash of the baseline text, and a later baseline edit makes it read "stale".
- **Every mutation** re-checks authorization inside its transaction, needs `If-Match` (428/409) and writes one audit event. The read-only auditor gets 403 on every mutation, and the denial is audited.

**Checks (final tree):** 56 files / 1146 unit tests in both locales, and 43 files / 655 integration tests; typecheck, build, lint, `openapi:lint` (270 operations) and Prettier all pass. The DG2 historical validation passed at start and end.
- **New tests:** 20 unit tests in `totals.test.ts`, including the two playbook examples (100000 and 500000). There are also 17 integration tests in `business-cases.test.ts`.
- **Control run:** six of the integration tests revoke a grant while a write is blocked, after the request was authenticated. Run without the in-transaction re-check, that test failed with a 201 (the line was written), so the test really detects it. Case creation can't be blocked that way, so it relies on code review.

**Pinned counts in `contract.test.ts`:** media-type triple `[90, 89, 1]` → `[97, 96, 1]`, rate-limit floor `>= 167` → `>= 178`. My pending list is now empty.

**Needs your decision:**
- **`packages/shared/src/schemas/index.ts` (BE-A's):** I added one export line for my schemas. Without it the API can't import them and the tree doesn't typecheck. KBE-C will need the same line for its schemas.
- **`apps/api/src/modules/kpi/kpi.test.ts` (no P3 owner):** it pins the kpi module's operations (24 → 35), write permissions and public exports, so routing my operations necessarily breaks it. KBE-C will have to extend the same pins.
- **`@mth/shared/calc` isn't on the API module allowlist:** the architecture test rejected my unit test's import of the formula engine, so I removed it and used the engine's stored results instead. BE-D and KBE-C will hit the same rule; BE-A or you should add the package to the allowlist.
- **Problem texts:** ADR-0024 has no English text for most of the new `business_case.*` codes, so I wrote them (listed in the handback for the architect to adopt).
- **Choices to confirm:**
  - Net value is Unknown unless both benefits and costs have a known amount in that currency.
  - The transformation case's "at least one line" check counts its initiative cases' lines.
  - "Author" for the validation rule means the case's creator, matching the database check.

The run also left empty `.claude/.cc-writes` folders in source directories when my shell moved into them; I removed them, and they briefly broke the architecture test. All earlier failed runs are disclosed in the handback.

Files are in `/home/user/wt/dg3-kbe-b/docs/delivery/handbacks/DG3/`:
- `T-DG3-KBE-B-kpi-benefits-engineer.md`
- `T-DG3-KBE-B-evidence/`
